question: Which three places are named as abodes for the enumerated bhūta conditions?
premises: The verse names a dry tree as one location.
The verse names a cremation ground as another location.
The verse names a plakṣa-śleṣmāta-śigru compound as a third location.
inference: These three locations are the places associated with the ten bhūta conditions enumerated in the preceding verses.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the compound plakṣa-śleṣmāta-śigru is not resolved by this verse alone.
